controller_12m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p276 ('(B) Undertakings by our Controlling Shareholders'). CONVENTION CORRECTION: the combined undertaking restricts disposals 'in the period ... ending on the date which is twelve months from the Listing Date (the "Twelve-Month Period")' - it ends ON the 12-month anniversary 2027-07-08, which is therefore the last restricted day; first free day is 2027-07-09.
